taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-01, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1056.4 | 23.97 | 23.97
2 | 1090.4 | 1.46 | 25.43
3 | 2606.8 | 3.17 | 28.60
4 | 3560.6 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as HA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-01, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-01 (Area T)**

**Layer Sequence Summary:**
* **Layer 1:** 1056.4 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 23.97 m (0.00–23.97 m depth)
* **Layer 2:** 1090.4 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 1.46 m (23.97–25.43 m depth)
* **Layer 3:** 2606.8 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 3.17 m (25.43–28.60 m depth)
* **Layer 4:** 3560.6 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, basement (>28.60 m depth)

**Curve Evaluation:**
Resistivity increases monotonically through the section ($r_1 < r_2 < r_3 < r_4$), yielding an **AA-type** (or A-type) sounding curve (A for layers 1–2–3 and A for layers 2–3–4). The existing archival classification of HA-type is inconsistent with the interpreted resistivity values, as there is no resistivity minimum ($r_1 > r_2 < r_3$).

{"curve_type_stated": "AA", "label_issue_flagged": true}
